changes: Keep successful metrics and continue later batches when a sibling request fails; attribute failures by record_id and metric_code.
After one corrected retry, split invalid tool JSON into smaller batches. Also split an output-limit response received during that corrected retry.

For a confirmed single-metric tool truncation with transformed_retry_allowed, make at most one plain-JSON recovery generation using the same input and a 16,000-token cap. Preserve the original receipt and apply the existing identity, JSON, size and financial-evidence checks.

live_recovery.note: The exact candidate code was exercised online. Its validated receipt was reused by the final full-scope reconciliation; the final v9 batch required no additional model requests.

runtime.future_calls: The standard launcher freezes ai_review_batch.py from acquisition-src into each new run and mounts that file read-only over the image module. The production source, release artifact and final run have identical SHA-256. A fresh production-image import from the production source confirmed issuer-batch-review-v9.
runtime.existing_runtime_dependencies: The existing acquisition image supplies requests, PyMuPDF, pyodbc and pilot_runtime; the retained launcher supplies the existing snapshot/OCR workflow. No image rebuild or schema migration was required.

preservation.verification: Source backups, frozen input copies and retained result files were checked with SHA-256. Old run directories remain intact; failed receipts and each new attempt remain available for audit.

limits: review_complete means the frozen review scope has been processed without request failures; evidence exceptions still require business review and are not approved financial values.

The upstream DeepSeek tool-output/usage discrepancy is not established as fixed. The bounded caller recovery handles this failure mode without increasing the primary budget or accepting incomplete JSON.
The initial diagnostic report is retained in GATEWAY-OUTPUT-AUDIT-2026-10-30.json; its deployment=false and v7 counts describe the earlier investigation, not the current release.
